name: clawgrab
description: Get the transcript of a public YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, SoundCloud or podcast link. AI summaries, posts and quotes with a free account.
long_description: ClawGrab turns a public video or audio link into clean transcript text for your AI. Transcripts are free with no account. The AI tools (summary, social posts, blog draft, quotes, translation) need a free ClawGrab account token: 5 AI outputs a month free, unlimited on Pro ($12/month).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Transcript of a public video or audio link (free, no account)

tools.name: summarize_text
tools.description: Short bullet summary of transcript text (account)

tools.name: generate_social_posts
tools.description: Social post drafts from transcript text (account)

tools.name: generate_blog_post
tools.description: Blog post draft from transcript text (account)

clawgrab_token.title: ClawGrab account token (optional)
clawgrab_token.description: Unlocks the AI tools. Free account: 5 AI outputs a month. See the README for how to get it. Leave empty for transcripts only.
